header: Run the whole site from the TYPO3 backend
subheadline: Four backend views in one install: compose, edit inline, theme and override. None of them needs code.

items.title: Pick from ten element groups
items.description: The content wizard sorts all 244 Desiderio elements into ten groups. Editors find the right hero, pricing table or footer without scrolling a long list.

image.title: Desiderio content wizard
image.alternative: The TYPO3 content wizard listing the ten Desiderio element groups.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.title: Edit inline in the Visual Editor
items.description: The Visual Editor shows the real page with the live theme, and editors type straight into it. What they see is what visitors get.

image.title: Editing in the Desiderio Visual Editor
image.alternative: The TYPO3 Visual Editor with a Desiderio page open for inline editing.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.title: Restyle the site from settings
items.description: Theme preset, dark mode, density, radius and fonts are in the site settings. A new preset changes every element, with no rebuild and no deployment.

image.title: Desiderio theme site settings
image.alternative: TYPO3 site settings showing the Desiderio theme options, including the preset.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.title: Give one section its own theme
items.description: A preset field in the page properties applies to that page and its subpages. Campaign pages or brand sections get their own look.

image.title: Per-page theme preset field
image.alternative: TYPO3 page properties with the Desiderio theme preset field.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.
